subject: Order Form + MSA: feedback / training / output ownership language
messages:
From: Sara Nolan <sara.nolan@innovexa.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: David Park <david.park@innovexa.com>, Legal Ops <legal_ops@innovexa.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Order Form redlines (training / output ownership concerns)

Karthik —

Thanks for sending over the draft order form and the MSA references. Our outside counsel ran a review and flagged three items that are blockers for our procurement: output ownership, model training / use of customer data, and the proposed "feedback" license.

High-level asks from Innovexa counsel:
- Customer must retain exclusive ownership of any generated output where the prompt and context are customer-provided (they call this "Customer Output").
- No use of Customer Data (including prompts, conversation logs, or attachments) for model training or improvement unless we explicitly opt in and sign a separate training/data use addendum.
- Any feedback or debugging logs provided to Redwood should be under a narrow license that permits Redwood to use only aggregated, de-identified information for product improvement and not to tie improvements back to Innovexa proprietary prompts or data.

I attached our redlines (PDF). Can your legal team propose alternative language that addresses these three points? If possible, we would like final language for both the MSA and the Order Form (we're trying to close by end of next week).

Appreciate a quick read.

—Sara

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Apr 2026 14:12:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: draft language for Innovexa redlines — candidate edits included

Karthik / Marcus —

I reviewed Innovexa's redlines and prepared candidate language. Summary of our position and rationale below; full tracked changes are in the attached doc.

1) Output ownership
- Proposal: Customer owns Customer Output defined as: "Outputs that are reasonably attributable to Customer-provided prompts, data, or attachments and are not standalone model artifacts." We avoid "exclusive" language that would imply Redwood cannot use aggregated or de-identified outputs for product-level benchmarks. We are willing to add a carve-out that prevents Redwood from using Customer Output for model training without explicit opt-in.

2) Training / data use
- Proposal: Default position is: Redwood will not use Customer Data (including prompts, files, and logs) to improve or further train models. We will provide an optional Order Form addendum ("Data Use Addendum") that, if checked, permits specific training under agreed scopes and timing. This aligns with our Private/Dedicated customers and enterprise expectations.

3) Feedback license
- Proposal: Customers grant Redwood a limited, perpetual, royalty-free license to use "Feedback" solely to improve the service, but we restrict Feedback to aggregated/de-identified telemetry and exclude Customer Output and Confidential Data. We include an explicit definition of Feedback and exclude any data marked or identified as "Confidential".

Risk notes: removing all usage rights for telemetry will materially degrade our ability to patch regressions and monitor production quality; the addendum model gives Innovexa control while allowing Redwood to maintain product health.

I attached a track-changes DOC with suggested MSA and Order Form edits. If you get a greenlight from Innovexa on the addendum approach, we can finalize this week.

-Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Legal Ops | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sara Nolan <sara.nolan@innovexa.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2026 15:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order Form redlines (training / output ownership concerns) — proposed compromise

Sara / David —

Following internal review, attached are our proposed tracked-change MSA and a draft Data Use Addendum for the Order Form. Short summary of the compromise language:

- Customer Output: Innovexa retains ownership of Customer Output (as defined). Redwood will not use Customer Output to train models unless Innovexa executes the Data Use Addendum.
- Data Use Addendum: opt-in checkbox on the Order Form. If selected, it specifies scope (datasets, duration, scrubbed/de-identification process) and allows Innovexa to revoke consent with 60 days' notice.
- Feedback: Innovexa grants Redwood a narrow, non-exclusive, perpetual, royalty-free license to use Feedback for service improvement, provided Feedback is aggregated/de-identified and expressly excludes Customer Output and any data marked Confidential.

If that aligns, next steps: please indicate approval of the tracked-change language (we can accept via email) and we will push the final Order Form + DocuSign link. If you prefer another round of edits, we can schedule a 30-min legal-to-legal call.

Proposed sign-off timeline: aim to have Order Form countersigned by 04/12 to meet Innovexa's Q2 deployment window.

Thanks — and thanks for the clear asks; this approach preserves Innovexa's IP protections while giving Redwood a pragmatic telemetry path to maintain product quality.

Best,
Karthik
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
